meta.title: Urbi — Our Product
meta.description: How we're building Urbi, the platform that brings parish councils and residents closer together — from concept to operational pilot.

hero.title: Urbi
hero.subtitle: One platform, one channel: residents report and follow along, the parish council manages, resolves and communicates. Simple for the people who live there, powerful for the people who take care of it.
hero.siteNote: Urbi's dedicated website is almost here.

problem.label: The Problem
problem.title: Reporting a local problem shouldn't be a problem
problem.intro: A broken streetlight, a pothole, overgrown weeds. Today, fixing the simplest of issues means phone calls, trips to the front desk and Facebook posts — followed by weeks of silence. And on the other side of that desk, things aren't any easier.
problem.card1Desc: Reports arrive by phone, email, social media and in person. Without a single system, information gets lost and nothing is traceable.
problem.card2Title: Reporters are left in the dark
problem.card2Desc: After reporting, residents rarely know whether anyone saw it, whether it's in progress or simply forgotten. Trust erodes with every silence.
problem.card3Desc: Teams, materials, work orders and history live on paper and in the heads of long-time staff. When someone leaves, the knowledge leaves with them.

solution.label: The Solution
solution.title: One channel, from report to resolution
solution.body: Urbi brings everything together. Residents report with a photo and a pin on the map, follow the status in real time and rate the resolution at the end. The parish council receives every report as a structured process — with deadlines, teams, materials and photographic proof that it actually got fixed.

features.label: The Platform
features.title: Built for both sides of the counter

residents.title: For residents
items: Report issues with a photo and a location on the map
Follow every step, with public deadlines and notifications
Support neighbours' reports to raise their priority
News and alerts in a single feed — and on the map
Polls, suggestions and questions straight to the council
Public statistics: what got fixed, and how fast

junta.title: For the parish council
items: Geo-referenced dashboard with every report and KPIs
Administrative workflow with customisable states
Team, shift, vehicle and equipment management
Stock with minimum-level alerts and automatic deduction
Financial planning, reports and public accountability
Full audit trail and GDPR compliance

ai.title: Artificial intelligence
items: Detection of duplicates and chronic problems
Reports created automatically from email and social media
Emails to external entities drafted and tracked by AI
Work orders filled in by voice, in the field
Critical streets and seasonal trends identified automatically
Fallbacks for everything: if the AI fails, the platform keeps working

build.label: Inside the Development
build.title: How we're building Urbi
build.p1: Urbi was born in an academic context, but it stopped being an exercise early on. We spent months listening to the people who work in parish councils and structuring the product properly: 13 functional modules, over 240 requirements and a data model with 68 entities — all before the first line of code.
build.p2: We develop full-stack in parallel: every phase delivers a complete increment — API, web and mobile — which we demo to our pilot partner before moving on. Nobody likes waiting a year to see the product working; neither do we.
build.p3: In 2026 we made the leap from paper to product: we started building the platform for real and we're preparing the operational pilot with our first parish council for November.
build.h1Desc: Every phase closes with working API, web and mobile. Nothing gets left “for later”.
build.h2Desc: Our pilot partner sees, tests and gives feedback throughout the development — not just at the end.
build.h3Desc: WCAG 2.1 AA, short flows and readable text. Designed for the least digital residents too.
build.h4Desc: Multi-tenant with data isolation, GDPR, immutable audit logs and verified backups.

dotnet.name: .NET 10
dotnet.reason: The backbone of the platform. Performance, reliability and a mature ecosystem to treat the data of thousands of residents with the seriousness it deserves.

postgres.name: PostgreSQL + PostGIS
postgres.reason: Every report is a point on the map. PostGIS gives us native geospatial queries — from critical zones to the boundaries of each parish.

react.name: React
react.reason: The council's dashboard is built with React: fast, responsive and easy to evolve as the platform grows.

reactNative.name: React Native
reactNative.reason: One codebase, two platforms and full feature parity — staff can do on their phone everything they do on a computer.

signalr.name: SignalR
signalr.reason: Instant notifications and updates. When a report's status changes, everyone knows right away.

azure.name: Azure
azure.reason: Managed infrastructure, automatic backups and Azure OpenAI powering the platform's intelligence layer.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: Proxio Solutions ('we', 'us', or 'our') is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard the information you provide when using our website and services, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable Portuguese law.

controller.title: Data Controller
controller.body: The data controller responsible for your personal data is Proxio Solutions, based in Portugal. For any data-related enquiries, please contact us at: proxiosolutions@gmail.com

dataCollected.title: What Data We Collect
dataCollected.body: We only collect personal data that you voluntarily provide when using our contact form. This may include:
items: Full name
Email address
Subject and message content you submit

usage.title: How We Use Your Data
usage.body: The personal data you provide is used exclusively to respond to your enquiry and to maintain correspondence with you. We do not use your data for marketing or profiling purposes without your explicit consent.

legal.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legal.body: We process your personal data on the following legal grounds under the GDPR: your consent (Article 6(1)(a)), given when you submit our contact form; and our legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries (Article 6(1)(f)).

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected, or as required by applicable law. Contact enquiry data is generally retained for up to 2 years, after which it is securely deleted.

thirdParties.title: Third Parties
thirdParties.body: We do not sell, rent, or transfer your personal data to third parties for their own use. We may use trusted third-party service providers (such as email or hosting services) who process data on our behalf and are bound by strict data processing agreements and confidentiality obligations.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: As a data subject under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
items: Right of access — obtain a copy of your personal data
Right to rectification — correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Right to erasure — request deletion of your data ('right to be forgotten')
Right to restriction — request that we limit the processing of your data
Right to object — object to the processing of your data
Right to lodge a complaint with the CNPD (Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados) at www.cnpd.pt

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Our website uses only strictly necessary technical cookies, such as storing your language preference. We do not use tracking, analytics, or advertising cookies. No personal data is collected through cookies.

contact.title: Contact & Data Requests
contact.body: To exercise any of your rights, ask questions about this Privacy Policy, or submit a data request, please contact us at: proxiosolutions@gmail.com. We will respond within 30 days.
